He worked harder than anyone, but the world never gave him a chance.
Crushed by disappointment, he finally lost even the will to try.
A woman who stayed by his side couldn't stay silent about the change.

The story of a man disappointed in the world and the woman who supports him.

He dreamed of wealth. While classmates studied, he chased high-paying jobs,
and built startup capital while friends played.
All to be a billionaire...

Some called him money-grubbing. He didn't mind.
Even risking his life, he wouldn't hesitate.


The story of a man betting everything on wealth.

There are all kinds of jobs in the world.
Some use their heads, others their bodies.

He moved his body rather than his head, and above all, he was positive.
That gave him strength to overcome the hardships ahead.

The story of a positive man's life.

Life isn't fair. Some are promised a tomorrow, some aren't.
The girl never could leave the hospital...

A nurse had cared for her for years...
Closer than family, both prepared for the farewell.

The story of a girl who fears tomorrow and a nurse who prepares for goodbye.

After an accident took her parents, only her brother remained.
She worked; he stayed home alone.

Sorry, she took him to the seaside when she could.
Tomorrow she'd leave again, so every moment mattered.

Moments that would never return.

A sister's apology for not staying with her brother.

The man loved this town: his hometown, where he would live on.
He loved the town and its people.

As he walked around, he thought:
Someday, when a great crisis comes, I will definitely help!

The story of a man who loves his hometown.

The butler boy admired the young lady of another world, and it became love.
She admired him too, and that became love.

They knew each other's feelings, but a wall stood between them.
Days passed pouring feelings into quiet glances...

The story of two who were drawn together but could never be.

A man burned with ambition.
Fed up with home, he studied to escape.
Poor, uncertain future...
Study was his only way.
Hard work won him a city job.

But his parents fell ill.
If he left,
none would care for them.
He had to give one up.
An ambitious man's choice.

A loving couple.
They couldn't be together daily
since he worked far away.

When he left, she packed his bags with all her heart,
praying he'd return safely...
She stuck their daughters' sticker on it
and said, "Have a safe trip."

A wife waiting for her husband.

A breadwinner carries a heavy burden.

To raise and protect his family, he sacrifices himself.
He gives up his dreams, even his pride...
However hard it gets, he can't run.
Only then can he protect them.

He keeps protecting them, sacrificing much.

A breadwinner who works for his family.

His passionate boss treated him like a younger brother,
and he looked up to him.

Passionate and sincere, the boss led everything...
Then came a "notice to resign."
Asked to accept it, he smiled wryly:

They just didn't need me...


A man who sees cruel reality in his boss's retirement.

She was his "first love."
Smitten by her kindness,
he was just a "junior."
Still, his heart leapt around her.

He was her very first "junior."
She learned the joy of teaching.
She came by to help with his work,
unaware it was more than friendship.


Two who keep missing each other.

The boy loved his father above all.
To him he was a dad, friend,
goal, and hero.
Everything to him.
Until robbers attacked his father...

His father lit the dark night,
lighting dark streets in all colors,
brighter than the stars.

The story of a boy adoring his father, who shone brightest.

A boy who loved hero movies,
knew they were "fiction,"
yet wanted to be one.

Believing power awakens at one's limit,
he worked until exhausted,
but reality wasn't a movie.
He was just ordinary.

He never gave up.
His power would surely awaken...


An ordinary boy's heroic dream.

Life in a secret organization has rules.
Never speak of missions; obey absolutely.
You climb a complicated mountain path to work,
and sometimes accept what isn't yours.

But to stay, there's no choice.
Refuse, and they'll take something precious...

Life as a secret organization member.

His only joy was gazing at "her."
He read her manga, bought her goods,
and chatted with her fans.
It kept him alive in a nightmare.
One day he decided:
he'd meet her in the real world.
With all his knowledge,
he'd bring her here!

A man living to meet his fantasy girl.

A robot with a "difference" faced scrapping.
It wanted to live.

A human gave up his "difference"
and was left in despair.

Each saw what they lacked.

By chance or fate,
they found life in each other
and stayed together to the end...


Robot and human finding life in each other.

He was always sweat-soaked.
He worked in danger,
and she could only watch.
Afraid, but needed to,
he took the job.
She hated that, so she fixed
his tools and reinforced
what had grown fragile.

Why him? She didn't know.
No, she pretended not to.

A woman who somehow worried.

A robot was always beside the woman he watched.
It was her life and all she'd staked.
He hated that she thought only of it.
To learn why, he became a robot pilot.
Yet she looked only at the robot.
He felt worse,
not knowing why.
No, he pretended not to know.

A robot pilot jealous of a robot.

His sin always tormented him.
Whatever the reason,
he couldn't look away.
Yet he feared death, clinging to life.
Each night he begged God's forgiveness.
Nobody listened, but it steadied him.
But he knew, however he begged,
the day to atone would come...

A man begging forgiveness under his sin.

Only those passing a long selection return.
Returnees are the talented,
weak-pointed, or quick-rich dreamers.
He was weak-pointed:
debt always bound his life,
and this job used it.
He resolved to escape someday
and live an ordinary life...


A man tossed by debt, struggling for freedom.

His wife died the day their girl was born.
Gray-gowned people came:
"Let her work for the world."
He refused to give up his wife's gift.
So she lived under strict rules.
It was how she'd survive.
His last dream:
to finish the "Dream Ship" and free her...

A girl in a not-prison, and her father.

A simple safety helmet. But nothing is more reassuring than wearing it.
That's right, I fear nothing, neither the trends of the world nor other people's eyes.

When I started the shop, I relied on many people around me.
"Young entrepreneur" sounds nice, but it isn't like that.
One reason was inexperience.
I act like I know things, but I'm a greenhorn...
The merchants knew that too.
They even decorated my shop with flowers for the opening.

Digging the ground is one thing, but I'm confident at laying bricks too.
Stacking bricks in neat order... how do I put it, the sense of accomplishment when it's finished is the best!
The guy at the site praised me, saying this job is my calling...
but I'm not sure whether I should take that at face value.

The bed that girl spent most of her days in.
A small child's bed, with stickers of her favorite characters
stuck all over it...
I think it's very childlike and nice.

The straw hat my brother wore whenever we went to the seaside.
An essential for protecting him from the summer heat and UV rays.
He'd swing his fist around saying, "I'm going to be a man of the sea!"...
what was that all about?
I really don't understand boys.

Pipes that carry water all over town.
Connecting them is a huge hassle, but when you've connected them all, you feel like you've accomplished something.
When something hits a pipe, the clear metallic sound echoing underground...
strangely, it calms my heart.

I often watched the young lady's back as she faced the mirror.
Sitting in her chair, saying nothing... just staring at the mirror...
A coward, I would secretly peek at her face reflected in the mirror from behind.
When our eyes happened to meet, I desperately tried to play it off.

To think I'd have a space of my own...
I couldn't have imagined it back home.
We shared everything there.
Just a narrow cabinet.
But it is unmistakably my own space...
Others will never understand
how much that means.

Whenever he had to go far away,
I was the one to pack his luggage,
praying with all my heart he'd return safely...
Our two daughters stuck stickers on his bag.
When I handed it over, telling him to be careful,
he looked at the stickers and smiled gently.

I'm truly a slave of the modern age...
I shrink back before the imposing sight of this giant lump of iron.
The heat soaked up from the sun and the ground
mixes with the particular smell of asphalt and chokes me.
If it weren't for the children waiting for me at home, I would surely have run away.

The air in the office was always bone dry.
Was it the dryness, or the tension in the air...?
The humidifier was always left on.
He always turned on the humidifier when he arrived at work.
Was he trying to ease this dry air...?

My senior picked up the oil can and laughed innocently, like a little girl.
I said I'd do it myself and tried to take it from her.
But she said she'd do it instead, and told me to rest...
Her will was firm, so I gave in.

The neon sign that lights up the town entrance
is this town's pride.
Because my dad made it!
In the daytime it doesn't look like much,
but at night it shines beautifully!
It's way more amazing than the starry sky!

Washing windows in midair, concentration is everything...
If your focus breaks, it can lead to a terrible accident.
When I somehow finish wiping them all,
every muscle in my body screams... uuugh.
It's that hard a job.

A newly assigned building, newly assigned duties,
a newly assigned box... huh, a monitor?
When I received a monitor from an incredibly bygone era,
I doubted my own eyes, wondering if I'd been demoted.

No matter how far machines have advanced, there must be things only people can do.
That's why even someone like me has a job.
What I should do now is use this, even if it wears me down, to make her happy.

An air doll that starts dancing when air is pumped in.
The machine part below adjusts the air so it moves as if dancing.
The doctor at the hospital across the street was amazed that without "joints" it could move like this.
He compared this thing to a "human"... what an odd person.

I still like digging best.
A man isn't a man until he can handle a shovel!
Some say it's hard on the body, but it's no trouble at all for me.
Being able to work with an empty head is more than I could ask for.

My parents, who didn't know what to do about the girl pleading to go outside,
brought this wheelchair.
It was small and not expensive,
but it was her only means to reach the outside world.

A cooler box keeps food cold even at the summer seaside.
My brother forgets a lot of things, but he never forgot the cooler box.
It's stuffed with his favorite ice cream, after all.
Sneaking a bite while he's absorbed in playing in the water is another little joy.

In the darkness spreading underground, this flashlight is the only guidepost...
To me, who wasn't used to the dark,
this flashlight was the most precious thing.

A chair always placed facing the window.
On rainy days, the young lady always sat in that chair, gazing blankly out the window.
Maybe she wants someone to talk to...
I thought so and approached, and she smiled at me just once.
Then she turned her eyes silently to the window again.

I will never forget how I sat on the cold floor
and clung to my studies at a wobbly desk.
In a bad way, of course.
And yet, what a sturdy desk this is.
With this, it feels like everything will work out.

They say people heading off for work far away
always put on an oxygen respirator when boarding the plane.
So that they can breathe even high in the sky.
I told him over and over to check
the oxygen respirator first when he boarded.

A yellow barricade that protects workers from the flow of passing cars.
It surrounds the work site on the wide highway.
It keeps outsiders from entering,
but we aren't allowed to leave either.
The yellow stripes start to look like prison bars.

My boss disappeared along with a large box.
Loyalty to the company and passion, not a single thing remained...
Was his passion not enough?
Or was it a lack of ability?
...What's certain is the fact that he wasn't needed.

When she came to the workplace, the first thing my senior did was inspect the fire extinguisher.
And she taught me how to use it properly.
Her fire extinguisher lectures continued not just for me but for all the staff.
She seems like a born teacher.

When my tall dad climbed the ladder,
his hands looked like they could reach the sky.
When dad climbed the ladder,
I'd climb up from the other side with him.
Dad laughed and said I was good,
but Mom screamed that it was dangerous.

Every time the lifeline holding my body trembled, my heart pounded too.
Movie heroes always fly through the sky,
so how do they endure that fear?
Well, I guess it's only possible because it isn't real.

Was this company once in the paper or printing business...?
Only the shredder is proudly installed...
What on earth did this company do?
Maybe it was some kind of secret organization...

A toolbox she bought with money she saved to commemorate my first day at work.
It's from a famous maker, so it must have been expensive...
There's a small note inside the box.
A short line that says "Do your best." Huh... my vision's blurring and I can't read it properly...

A young entrepreneur's biggest struggle is probably a novel business.
This menu board explains it in detail.
It's a masterpiece I wrote after pulling all-nighters for days.
I could have paid a vendor, but I have to save every bit I can.

The site itself doesn't bother me, but please spare me from carrying cement bags.
They're seriously no joke heavy.
After I finish carrying them, my whole body goes limp.

A big teddy bear that girl never let out of her sight.
She'd say all the time that she wanted to touch a real bear at the zoo someday.
That a single swipe from a bear has the impact of 1 ton...
there's probably no need to tell her.

My brother can't swim, so he always uses a swim ring.
It has to have his favorite character on it.
It's a little childish, but it strangely suits him.
I guess he's at the age where things like that suit him.

This can clear all kinds of clogs,
but the stench is proportional to how long it was clogged.
The smell is so bad it can make you hate working here...
But in front of the seniors who've done this for decades, I could never say so.

The young lady loved evening walks.
When the moon was shining, she would deliberately walk through dark thickets,
and on moonless nights she would quietly come close and press this lantern into my hand.
Holding back my soaring happiness,
I quietly followed behind the young lady.

I never had anything I could call trash.
Paper, towels, plastic bags... I reused everything.
But it's different here.
Everything that has served its purpose goes into this trash can.
There's no room for hesitation.

One day, he gave our daughters life jackets as a present.
Probably because the younger one threw a fit, wanting clothes like Daddy's.
At first I thought it was a fake,
but while the girls were playing, a parachute suddenly opened.
I never imagined it was real...

A device that guides cars through a construction site onto another road.
Its colors are so bright they make your eyes flicker. Is that okay?
But beginner or dozing off...
sometimes a car ignores the route and charges at us...
I could never let my guard down.

My sincere and passionate boss also had lots of work.
I would look at his bookshelf half in disbelief.
Each time, without even turning around, he would ask
"Want to go for a smoke?"
It was as if he had eyes in the back of his head.

Whenever she came to the workplace,
she was always carrying an oil tank.
To refill the oil for the indoor heating.
I asked why she always filled it for us,
but she only smiled.

Whenever dad went to work, I always tagged along
and played with the cables.
I'd sit on them like a chair with the yellow side down,
or pull the black wire all the way,
winding it up as I ran around.
When dad called me, I'd run over
and be his electric-wire man!

I was drawn in by a high-paying, paid-in-cash job and ended up sitting in this chair.
But partway through, hanging in midair, I started wondering what the point of sitting here was.
On top of that, I forget things a lot and kept going up and down...
I deeply resented my careless nature.

Can anyone really work at a desk like this?
Looking at this desk, cramped even for one, makes me doubt it.
Above all, I'm worried about actually working at a desk like this.
No, no, surely not work at this desk...? Really...?

While I was pounding with a heavy hammer,
one day I was struck by pain that felt like my wrist would snap.
They told me it was because I hadn't got the knack yet,
but I think they've just gone numb.

My boss's careful consideration could be seen all over the company.
The light switches, the various equipment...
He always came first to turn them on,
and left last after turning them off.
This electric heater is one of those too.
His consideration always kept us warm.

When I said I didn't want her getting in the way of my work,
she started sweeping with the plastic broom in the corner.
But when I warned her again, it must have really got on her nerves.
She suddenly started rattling off a rapid-fire tirade.

When I went to work with dad,
he always made me wear this helmet.
Because the site is dangerous,
and accidents happen if kids run around...
Yep, safety first!

If I slip on this detergent, I'd be in the next world in no time, right...?
When I was fretting about that, the chief said,
"I'll kick your butt!"
I was really worried...
Everyone laughs and says I'm cute, but I thought I'd die from the frustration.

A floor cushion no one knows who used...
and it's full of signs of living, too...
It looks like someone was working here.
No idea what kind of work, though...

The light of my life, my destined one... my beloved Lucy-chan's limited-edition figure!
You can't imagine how hard I worked to get it...
The hardship alone could be made into a movie!

This is the limited-edition bromide that came with the DVD of
"Nyan Nyan ☆ Princess Lucy ~The Great Crystal Adventure~"!
How about that, envious? Hahaha!
It's an ultra-rare item, with only 500 ever made!
It reproduces Lucy-chan's cute figure exactly!
Ahh, Lucy-chan...

This is a special item that gives me blissful moments.
I can't even sleep without it anymore!
If I sleep holding it, I can meet Lucy-chan even in my dreams!

If Lucy-chan really existed,
her height would probably be about this much... and her weight about this much...?
Ahh, someday I want to talk to her in person.
The real her must be even cuter and sexier than I imagine!

This is a tool called a mop.
It has cloth hanging from a long wooden pole.
The key to using this tool is how much force you apply.
When I pushed forward with force, the tool didn't move and only I fell over.
There was a risk of damaging my leg joints,
but Master laughed out loud... Why?

This is a tool called a duster. It is used to brush off dust.
The 4 colors are striking.
They're like the colors of "emotions" that only my eyes can see...
Oops, Master yelled at me to hurry up and clean.
I must clean quickly...

This is a tool called a vacuum cleaner.
When activated, it makes a grating noise.
I asked Master if it was a weapon that generates noise, and got scolded.
It is very impressive how it sucks up dust and trash.
However, I find it somewhat inconvenient that it cannot choose what it sucks up.

This is a tool called a spray bottle. When you pull the lever, water sprays from the hole in front.
Master told me to spray water where it's needed while cleaning.
Cleaning with two tools at once...!
An unusual item that raises the difficulty of cleaning the moment you use it... how terrifying!

If you swing a pickaxe down on hard ground by mistake, your hands get wrecked, right?
Tingling from your fingertips like you've been electrocuted.
You've got to be a bit more careful at work...
I don't know what hot-headed fool is rushing us,
but things don't go that smoothly!

Dynamite accidents happen all the time.
If you use it wrong, it's an extremely dangerous thing
that can drag in not only yourself but your comrades.
I'm always on edge, afraid I'll be told to use it.
Please, don't let that ever happen...

They say he goes through dark tunnels every day.
So I made him a helmet with a light attached so he wouldn't get lost in the tunnels.
Of course, since I'm not in charge of tools,
I'll probably get glared at from above for doing this...
But I can't trust things other people make, so I had no choice.

They say the mine cart he pulls easily exceeds 500 kg.
You'd think that's absurd,
but if he doesn't pull it, the people behind him have a terrible time...
Still, he should take a little care of his own body... what a fool.

What surprised me was when that guy used a plastic model
to develop a real robot.
Is this what they call a successful otaku?
Not an otaku but a maniac? Whatever.
Anyway, his love for robots is no joke!

When I asked what's so good about that junk heap,
he swung the welder at me.
...Geez, I almost got burned!
He's usually so quiet, but he's a different person when it comes to robots.
Haah... what on earth is so good about them...

The way he works wearing a welding mask
looks like a professional engineer...
So I told him he looks coolest in the mask,
and he got really grumpy.
Did I say something wrong?

These gloves have a special coating
that protects against the welder's high heat and high voltage.
When he wears them, only his hands look huge.
I said, "You look like a robot!" and he was overjoyed.
I didn't mean it as a compliment... well, I guess tastes differ...

A mini fridge holding drinks to quench a dry throat.
Without it, I couldn't have endured the thirst
that comes from the pressure.
It's the most satisfying thing I get from the company.

Company-issued equipment.
Nothing but issued equipment can be used here.
Even if you own something better,
you have no choice but to use this.

A laptop issued by the company.
I used it to manage the members involved in the experiment.
Everything I wrote was saved directly to the company's main computer.
It felt like I was being watched all the time.

If I turn off the lab lights and leave only the desk lamp on,
it creates just the right atmosphere for thinking.
So every night I would sink into thought.
It always ends with a prayer
begging forgiveness for all the sins I committed in 1 day...

A radio is essential when they patrol the building.
You can call for help if something happens.
But what danger could there possibly be here...?
I'm starting to get paranoid.

A baton can be a weapon to intimidate humans.
But what if the opponent is a psychic?
Swinging it might just get us killed...
Those guys probably think of us as "livestock" anyway.

With this, I feel a little better.
In this secret base where danger could strike at any time,
this is the only thing I can rely on.
It should at least buy me enough time to run.

The person in charge who handed me this told me to shoot anything suspicious without hesitation.
Why would anything suspicious come here?
And what is the "secret" they want to hide?
Well, let's keep the curiosity to this much.
Still, as long as I don't know this secret, I feel like I can't get out of here.

The surface is all spiky, just like the scissors we have at home.
I asked Daddy if I could touch the saw blade just once, but he got startled and took it away.
I'm not even hurt... Daddy's such a worrywart!

Wood cut into squares.
It was fun to line them up and cross them sideways like a crab, or walk in a straight line with both arms spread like on a balance beam.
If Daddy finds out I'll get in big trouble, so I have to play in secret.

When I asked Daddy if I could ride the rubber boat,
he said, "Kids shouldn't get on boats. You promised not to ride things like this in exchange for living here."
Daddy looked like he was about to cry, so I didn't ask any more, but I still don't understand why I can't ride a boat.

A model of the ship Daddy and the uncles were building.
It's super cool! When it's finished, I wonder if they'll let me ride it at least once?
If so, I could go to the countries beyond the sea that I read about in books...

I ended up here by chance, but I should at least take something home. What can I carry back... only a psychic ability.
They say a lost fool nearly died and gained one. Why not try?
Of course, I'm not stupid enough to risk my life.

The story of a mercenary trying to obtain a psychic ability.

In the hardest times, they banded together to survive the Void, clinging to a small, fleeting hope...
So they could pass that hope on someday, they left letters behind.

The story of a woman who may still be alive where nothing remains.

Um... where's the sergeant? Shouldn't we look?
Wandered off again? Too quiet...
What now?
Report to the leader; alone we'd get lost.
Ugh... I'd rather not.
Right? Return while it's safe.
When did he learn stealth...

A soldier who suddenly went missing.

The boy admired the hero who saved all.
Grown, he entered the ruined world
and became a hero.
They called him "Rescuer."
He gathered rescuers to stop the war.
But someone ended his story there.
...How about this story, Lord?

Lord, who abandoned his believers, and me.

Old Document Box

Plenty of it broke when we went into the Void, but... this should still be usable, right?
It beats sleeping on the floor.

Sign here, here, and also here, and you can use the equipment.
I'll hand you the instructions later.
...Does anyone actually read contracts these days?
They didn't even before the Void, so it's fine, right~?

Don't you think it's a bit underwhelming as a gun for us soldiers?
Even though it was made with NED's support.
It's absurd that we have to empty a magazine just to take down a Vessi, let alone Soul Junk.
We'd be taken out before we ran out of ammo.
Honestly... it only buys time.

This document box? Oh, it's nothing special. I just happen to enjoy keeping records.
I write down most things.
A laptop? Hmm... that's not bad, but it lacks an analog feel.
The charm of records is writing them on paper and turning the pages as you read.
Broken Turntable
Mercenary's Destroyed Gun
Lost Helmet
Empty IV Drip

It doesn't look broken, but without a record we can't listen to it.
Tenebris, if you aren't going to use it, can I give it to someone else?

Ralph was certain he could never be taken down by an illusion.
That is, until he saw one for himself and learned bullets don't work on it.
All Ralph could do was bash the illusion with his firearm or fire bullets that wouldn't even hit.

A helmet made with excellent bulletproof fibers.
It surprised many by stopping not just sniping but close- and mid-range fire.
But few wore it, since it was developed after the Void, when thermal weapons targeted Soul Junk and Vessi.

This liquid? You finally ask a question after so long, and your curiosity kicks in again. If I must explain, it's energy.
Highly concentrated Desire Energy, at that.
It's going into your body. How do you feel?
Excited, aren't you?

Someone's Mask

The head of a small teddy bear, with no owner to cherish it and no one to repair it.
